name: Salmon floss
summary: Ruốc cá hồi is the salmon floss the falls page says you can buy to carry home. A jar size and a price were not printed.
origin: Named at nhà hàng thác Bạc Sa Pa, as a gift from the restaurant, not as a plated course.
howToEat: Buy it to carry. How it is eaten at the table was not printed. Check on arrival.
where: Nhà hàng thác Bạc Sa Pa, near the gate. A festival note also names ruốc at the cold-water fish yard in tổ 14, Ô Quý Hồ, near the falls.
seoTitle: Salmon floss in Sapa — a falls-gate gift
seoDescription: Ruốc cá hồi to carry from nhà hàng thác Bạc. A jar price is Check on arrival.
